name: UGC 1703 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 1703, an isolated dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc1703-hubble
story: UGC 1703 is a faint dwarf galaxy keeping its own company, a quiet spheroidal or transition-type dwarf. Hubble looked at it to measure its distance from the brightness of its red giant stars.

claims.text: UGC 1703 is a local isolated dwarf galaxy of type dSph/dTr (spheroidal or transition-type dwarf)
UGC 1703 is a target of Hubble program 12546 at this position, imaged with ACS in F606W and F814W
The program measures distances from stars at the Tip of the Red Giant Branch
